name: quota-saver
description: Makes your Claude Code quota last longer. English + Roman Urdu.

setupLocalModel.title: Local model (Ollama) setup
setupLocalModel.description: yes: pehle session mein Ollama aur model khud install ho jaayenge, aam sawal free. ask: pehli dafa poochega. no: band (baad mein /local on).

maxOutputChars.title: Max tool output (characters)
maxOutputChars.description: Is se lamba Bash/MCP/web output chhota kar diya jaata hai (errors aur aakhri lines rakh kar).

maxReadKB.title: Max full-file read (KB)
maxReadKB.description: Is se bari file poori parhne se pehle Claude ko Grep ya offset/limit use karne ko kaha jaata hai.

dedupeReads.title: Block repeat reads
dedupeReads.description: Jo file pehle parh li aur badli nahi, use dobara parhne se roko.

autoIntent.title: Auto task detection
autoIntent.description: Prompt se kaam ki qism (fix, samjhao, test, review, banao) khud pehchaan kar mukhtasar hidayat saath bhejo.

localCache.title: Local answer cache
localCache.description: Pehle pooche gaye sawal ka jawab local se do (0 tokens). '!' se shuru karein to naya jawab.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Local model server ka pata (/local on ke liye).
